title: The Salt Barge Surcharge
story: Mr 6 rides a salt barge down the Amber Canal when Scrimshank the Barge Assessor clamps onto the rudder with his ledger-claws. 'Every barge pays a toll of 40 gold crowns,' he rasps, 'plus a canal surcharge of 15% of the toll, and then 25 crowns for the lock. But a knight who can total it before the lock closes rides free!' Mr 6 lifts his tiny quill and starts figuring.
question: What is the total toll in gold crowns that Scrimshank is demanding?
solution: The surcharge is 15% of 40 = 0.15 * 40 = 6 gold crowns.
Add the three pieces: 40 + 6 + 25 = 71 gold crowns.
The total toll is 71 gold crowns.
praise: Adding the toll and lock fee together was exactly right — the 15% surcharge was the one piece still waiting to join the pile.
hint: Find 15% of 40 first, then stack all three amounts together.
victory: Mr 6 read the total aloud so crisply that Scrimshank's ledger snapped shut on his own claw, and the barge slid through the lock toll-free.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight with a blue cape standing on a salt barge in a torchlit canal lock, facing a wiry ledger-clawed creature clutching a long scroll of fees, warm amber evening light.
